errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the value rose to ~50 in 1948 and was ~30 in 1950. According to the chart, the value in 1948 was very low (around 3), while the value in 1950 was a peak of approximately 51.
The description states the value in 1954 dropped to approximately 22. However, the chart shows the value at 1954 is clearly below 20, at approximately 14.

The description reports a data point for the year 1967 with a value of ~20. The chart's x-axis is marked in two-year intervals, and no data point exists for 1967. The line segment between 1966 (value ~49) and 1968 (value ~39) is a straight downward slope and does not dip to 20.
